name: The End of Doomsday
source:
A short, hopeful game about a sad monster who learns Doomsday is coming as part of the "Summer Slow Jams 2023: Narrative" game jam hosted by  Portland Indie Game Squad!

[From [url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/the-end-of-doomsday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只郁郁寡欢的怪物得知世界末日将至。这是一个短小却心怀希望的游戏，为波特兰独立游戏小组举办的“Summer Slow Jams 2023：叙事”游戏创作活动而作！

（来源：[url=https://ashleecraft.itch.io/the-end-of-doomsday]itch.io[/url]）
